user.title: Connect to Raspi-Sump
user.description: Enter the address of your raspi-sump web interface.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the Raspberry Pi running raspi-sump.
data_description.port: Port the web interface listens on. Use 443 when it is served over HTTPS.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off only for a self-signed certificate.
data_description.path: Only needed when a reverse proxy serves raspi-sump under a subpath, for example 'sump' for https://home.example.com/sump.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the raspi-sump web interface at that address.
error.unsupported_version: That raspi-sump instance does not provide the /api/status endpoint this integration needs. Upgrade raspi-sump on the Pi.

abort.already_configured: This raspi-sump instance is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll raspi-sump. There is no benefit to polling faster than the reading interval configured on the Pi.
